name: Toake Kousuke
source:
Kousuke is a student and a member of the soccer club. In his older brother's absence, he worries about his sister-in law Rin's lack of sense of danger (in a sexual sense) and tries to protect her from the shadows.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ01278744.html]DLsite[/url]]
